answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 21084 Country: AU Title: I am having fibroid in my uterus and doctor asked me to do a vaginal ultrasound test. So, after the test do i need to take ghusl or just make wudhu and pray. Question: Assalamvalaikum, I am having fibroid in my uterus and doctor asked me to do a vaginal ultrasound test. So, after the test do i need to take ghusl or just make wudhu and pray. allah hafiz Answer ID: 21084 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 465/465/M=1431) If during the test the semen is discharged with lust, then ghusl shall be wajib, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
